description: This file defines the 'Dimension' class, which provides methods and constants for handling and converting spreadsheet dimensions, such as width and height, in different units of measurement including centimeters, pixels, points, and Excel-specific units.

classes.name: Dimension
classes.description: A utility class for handling, converting, and calculating spreadsheet dimensions in various units.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Dimension object based on a dimension string, converting the value to internal units.

methods.name: width
methods.description: Returns the width of the dimension in pixels or cell units depending on the initial unit.

methods.name: height
methods.description: Returns the height of the dimension in points or converted units.

methods.name: toUnit
methods.description: Converts the stored dimension to a specified unit of measure, throwing an exception if the unit is invalid.
